source.name: SoccerNet-v2 Action Spotting
source.video_access: requires provider authorisation; no gated media downloaded by this selection tool

clip_window.sampling: uniform endpoints; exact decoded indices and JPEG hashes frozen after media access

selection_policy.match_assignment: fixed-hash order; reserve primary plus reserve quotas of the rarest category in each role before filling 60/20/20 whole-match capacities
selection_policy.human_references: write from neutral-ID sampled frames before comparing source labels
selection_policy.reserve_use: document visual rejection before any model run; never replace based on model performance
selection_policy.test_policy: internal holdout from official train; seal until prompts and example selection are frozen

execution_gate: check prior Dataset B match overlap
review event visibility and write human references from sampled frames
audit identical and near-duplicate sampled frames across roles
freeze exact image hashes and approved reference/example text
freeze prompts, balanced example counts, settings and context-budget check on development only

experiment_policy.baseline: fresh recognition using identical query frames and settings without examples
experiment_policy.coaching: request only after separately reviewed recognition; evaluate advice separately
